section: Tall units H. 198 | for base unit H. 78
source_pages: printed p.102-109 / PDF 104-111 (the straight positions; the corner tall units, the wall-hung H.132 unit and the single-elevation positions are not held)
family_naming_note: SAME FAMILY AS tall_h198.json, DIFFERENT SECTION - exactly as tall_h210_base78.json is to tall_h210.json. The catalog prints C7/C8 here against CE/CF on printed p.97-101; the physical family is one, 1980 tall on a 100 plinth.
family_keys_note: NO FAMILY-LEVEL DATA KEYS: tall_h198.json owns height_mm, plinth_h_mm, depths and collections for family 'Tall H.198', and 50_registry.rb refuses two files that state the same family fact.
door_versions_note: No data.door_versions: the split is recorded per type in gola_stack_top_to_bottom.
extraction_note: 2026-10-04, GROUP 1 OF THE CATALOG RECON (Andriy: generate what can be generated with confidence): printed p.102, 103, 104, 106, 107, 108, 109 - 39 codes in 16 types, every straight position. Each stack sums to 1980 in both executions; widths, depths and codes checked by script against the text layer. NOT HELD: printed p.104 position 3 and p.105 position 1 (C77564 / C77664 / C87564 / C87664, C77964 / C87964) and p.107 position 3 (C88654 / C88754); printed p.109 position 2 (C83659), whose custom-sized door is TOP-HUNG at H.198 where the H.210-234 twins print an rh or lh door - a different leaf, not a copied one. ONE ELEVATION, NOT TWO: these positions print a single profile, 19,5 over 55,5 with no gola column, and the fronts do not sum to the column - the same shape as printed p.41 (19,5 + 55,5 = 750 under H.78) and C68654 on printed p.121, both deliberately not held. A height we cannot name is a height we do not write down. Also not held: the corner tall units (Elda Q7b, corner placement) and the wall-hung H.132 unit on the same sheets.

Each front now says what it is - leaf 'door' (one hinged leaf, hinge_side per order, never guessed) or 'doors' (a pair) - read off the printed description in order, top to bottom; a front without a leaf is a drawer.

tall_oven_h60_jumbo_interior_drawers.wall_hung_note: NOT OFFERED: no 'Surch. for wall-hung version on page 548' line in this position's margin on printed p.108 (text layer, 2026-10-04). The depth-band glyph column was not swept on a render for this position - the margin line is the priced offer and is what is recorded.
tall_oven_h60_jumbo_interior_drawers.notes: Servo Drive p.567; LEGRABOX margin prices named, not coded. Extracted 2026-10-04 (group 1 of the catalog recon): codes, widths and depths checked by script against the text layer; the elevation is the section twin of the held H.210 / H.84 positions.

door_versions.note: TYPE-SCOPED, 2026-09-28 (Andriy, off CK7744 in the panel: 'two door heights, one for gola, one for handle'). Registry.lookup now reads door_versions from the unit type first and the family second. full_mm / gola_mm are the whole column, H and H - 30; shown_* are the numbers the page prints for the front that changes. joint false: the carcass-joint split of the base units does not apply to a recess part-way up a column.
